# Tender Response -- KMK-2026-03

Visakoivu Oy's response is structured against the evaluation criteria in Section 7.

## Eligibility

Visakoivu holds a valid LUSA-patevyys (valid to 2027-03-31) and reported turnover of EUR 20,300,000 for 2025, above the EUR 5,000,000 threshold.

## Price (50%)

Price is quoted in EUR/m2/year as required.

## Service levels and technical approach (35%)

Proposed SLA: 4-hour response for emergency faults, 24-hour response for urgent faults, completion within 5 working days for routine work. Building envelope condition is inspected annually by walkthrough combined with thermal imaging of the facades. Warranty on installed equipment and replacement parts: 24 months.

## References (15%)

Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue -- maintenance and LVI framework for five health centres, EUR 1,650,000, 2021-2024. Keski-Vaaran kaupunki -- LVI maintenance for school properties, EUR 1,120,000, 2023-2025.

## Other requirements

Asset register handover, commissioning after repairs, invoicing and the proposed contract period follow our standard terms. The Tender Form (Appendix 1) is attached, together with the occupational safety plan and a note on spare parts availability. CVs of key personnel are included.
